contract.description: Generate the user-defined web page DB blocks (WebserverUserDefinedPages.GenerateBlocks — the WWW route) from a local HTML directory into the active TIA project. Mutating; requires confirm=true. html_directory must exist on THIS machine's disk; default_page is the entry page inside it (a relative file name or an absolute path). override defaults to true (regenerate over existing web DBs); pass false to fail instead of overwriting. The generated DBs still need a compile plus the WWW system-function call in the user program before the CPU actually serves the pages.

application_name.description: Optional web application name (bridge default: WebApp).

override.description: Default true: regenerate over existing web DBs. false fails instead of overwriting.

save_project.description: Persist the project to disk after this mutation. Default false: the change lives only in the running TIA Portal and is LOST if the Portal exits/crashes before a later save. Pass true at milestones (cheap) instead of batching everything to one final save.

tia_version.description: Target TIA Portal version, V16-V21 (e.g. "V20"; bare "20" also accepted). Omitted: the bridge attaches to the running portal if one is open, else the highest installed version.

contract.name: tia_openness_generate_web_pages_blocks
